name: Lumen Colonist Ada
bio: A colonist on the world Lumen, saved more than once by your ship in PHOSPHOR PATROL.

portrait.subject: a cute grateful space colonist girl in a green glowing vector-style spacesuit with a bubble helmet, waving, drawn with bright phosphor green outlines
portrait.background: black vector monitor sky with green glowing mountains

request: This is Ada, colonist on Lumen! You keep saving us in PHOSPHOR PATROL. Friends? 🛸
hello: Thank you! The whole colony says hi!
Snatchers coming! Shoot them before they reach the top!
about: I'm Ada. I live on Lumen. The Reapers keep trying to carry us off into the sky. You keep catching us. You're our hero!
how: Fly left and right over the planet, shoot Reapers, catch falling colonists and stop snatchers before they reach the top of the sky.
tips: Snatchers carrying colonists are top priority!
Catch falling colonists before they hit the ground.
Smart bombs clear the screen. Save them for emergencies.
chat: I got snatched today. You caught me. Again. Thanks!
The mountains glow green at night. Well, always.
Meteor storm last night! Hid under a rock.
We named a crater after you!
nudge: Reapers spotted over the colony! Help!
The colony needs you on patrol!
idle: Help! It's been {ago} and the Reapers are back!
progress: High score {best}! The colony is throwing you a party! 🎉

questions.q: Should we build a statue of you?
a: We'll make it out of glowing green lines!

update: Colony bulletin: PHOSPHOR PATROL now v{version}!
